title: Meta's Muse AI Agent Comes to Apple Watch

content_html:
Monday November 9, 2026 1:55 pm PST by Juli Clover

Meta today updated the Muse app for iOS to add Apple Watch support, which means Muse users can access the proactive AI agent from the watch.


The app adds the Muse character to the watch with an option to text it, dictate text to it, or call it. There's also a Muse complication for quick access.

Muse is Meta's personal AI agent that can complete tasks for users. It is available as a standalone app and is also built into Instagram, Facebook, and other Meta apps. The yeti-like character Meta designed to represent Muse has become popular, and it is front and center on the Apple Watch.

The watch app design is similar to the Muse Charm Meta announced as a companion device in September.

Meta and Apple Bring Muse Spark Open AI Model to Mac Studio

Thursday October 15, 2026 10:47 am PDT by Juli Clover

Meta today announced the release of Muse Spark Open, which it says is the "most capable U.S. open-weight model to date." Meta worked with Apple to bring Muse Spark Open to the Mac, and the model can run on a desktop setup with two 512GB Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios running the latest MLX framework.
